flags.why: The example defines radium instead of showing the word in use.
flags.fix: Các nhà khoa học tìm thấy rađi trong mẫu quặng này. = The scientists found radium in this ore sample.

flags.why: Oản is made from glutinous rice flour and sugar, rather than pressed sticky rice ([traditional producer](https://tinhngoc.vn/san-pham/oan-khay-co/)).
flags.fix: truncated-cone-shaped sweet made from glutinous rice flour and sugar, offered at pagodas and altars

flags.why: The sporting sense refers to a basketball forward, not a football striker ([basketball teaching material](https://bongrotuoitre.vn/wp-content/uploads/2020/06/download-giao-an-bong-ro-bongrotuoitre.vn_.pdf)).
Ghi hai bàn places the example in football rather than the basketball sense.
flags.fix: Anh ấy chơi ở vị trí tiền phong trong đội bóng rổ. = He plays forward on the basketball team.

flags.why: Bạch chỉ does not mean a state of mental clarity.
Bà mắt lưng tròng is an unnatural construction in this sentence.
flags.fix: Nghe tin dữ, mắt bà lưng tròng. = Hearing the bad news, her eyes brimmed with tears.

flags.why: Kiến thiết remains current in formal usage and should not be labelled dated ([dictionary entry](https://vdict.com/ki%E1%BA%BFn%20thi%E1%BA%BFt%2C3%2C0%2C0.html)).
